cells.gaps: No report, review or evaluation against the policy's targets has been found. The ICT minister launched the reviewed policy on 7 March 2024 (ZWE-016); no adopting act is named. The body and finance facts (ZWE-008, ZWE-009) are dated 2022, outside the 36-month window, so governance is empty. cells.note: National ICT Policy 2022-2027: adopted, text public, period running to 2027, with an uncosted implementation plan of actions. Stage 4 needs a published report of results against the policy within three years, and none is held.
